## Summary

The "HUD": a single, unmissable, host-page-proof status pill that tells the user exactly what the assistant is doing — idle, listening (with live transcript), thinking, executing, clarifying, error.

It must be **invisible to the host page's CSS** and must not leak its own styles outward. That means a `ShadowRoot` with `mode: 'closed'` (or open, but with all styles scoped inside) plus a single fixed-position host element, high `z-index`, and no global selectors.

## Rendering architecture

```ts
// packages/extension/src/content/hud/mount.ts
export interface HudController {
  setStatus(status: AgentStatus): void;                 // from @vfe/protocol
  setTranscript(partial: string): void;                 // live preview while listening
  setMessage(text: string, kind?: 'info' | 'error'): void;
  setActionsProgress(done: number, total: number): void;
  setMicPermission(state: 'unknown' | 'granted' | 'denied'): void;
  showHint(text: string, ms?: number): void;
  destroy(): void;
}

export function mountHud(): HudController;
```

- Host element: `<vfe-hud>` custom element name (registered defensively — bail if already defined, so double-injection is harmless), `position: fixed; inset: auto 0 24px 0; display: flex; justify-content: center; z-index: 2147483647; pointer-events: none;` — the inner pill re-enables `pointer-events: auto`.
- All CSS lives in a single `style` tag **inside** the shadow root: `:host { all: initial; }` reset, explicit font stack (`system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif`), `box-sizing: border-box`, and **no** `@import`, no external fonts (CSP-safe).
- `mode: 'open'` for E-2/INT-1 internal access and for testability (Playwright can pierce open shadow roots; closed roots make automated UI tests miserable). Isolation comes from scoping, not from `mode: 'closed'`. Document this decision.
- Never use Tailwind in the content script (the build would inject a global preflight that breaks host pages). Hand-written CSS with CSS custom properties inside `:host`.
- Respect `prefers-reduced-motion` (disable the waveform animation) and `prefers-color-scheme` (light/dark tokens).
- Also handle: the host page calling `document.body.innerHTML = ''` (re-mount guard via a `MutationObserver` on `<html>` checking `hudHost.isConnected`, capped at 3 remounts/minute), and full-screen video/`element.requestFullscreen()` (the HUD is invisible in fullscreen — acceptable, document it).

## States & visual spec

| State | Visual | Copy |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `idle` | 44 px circular pill, subtle dark glass (`rgba(20,20,24,.86)`), mic glyph | hint `Alt+V` appears on hover; after 3 sessions also shows "Press Alt+V to talk" for 4 s on page load (dismissible, once per domain) |
| `listening` | pill expands to 320 px, animated 5-bar waveform (red/accent), transcript preview in 13 px grey, live | "Listening…" |
| `thinking` | spinner (CSS-only, `prefers-reduced-motion` → static dots), dimmed | "Mapping actions…" |
| `executing` | progress text + thin progress bar | "Filling 2 of 3…" |
| `clarifying` | accent border, question text (max 2 lines, ellipsis, title attr) | the Brain's `questionToUser` |
| `error` | red border, message + "Retry" affordance (click re-opens listening) | the error text |

Accessibility (non-negotiable):
- `role="status"` + `aria-live="polite"` on the message region; `aria-live="assertive"` only for `error`.
- The pill is a `<button>` with `aria-label="Voice form assistant: <state>. Press Alt+V to talk."`; keyboard focusable; `Esc` cancels listening; the focus ring must be visible on any page.
- Contrast ≥ 4.5:1 for text on the glass background in both schemes.
- The transcript preview is `aria-hidden="true"` (otherwise screen readers double-announce alongside TTS).

Animation budget: waveform uses `transform`/`opacity` only (compositor), max 5 bars at 60 fps, paused when `document.hidden`.

## Interaction flow

1. `Alt+V` (from SW command → content script) toggles listening. Also a click on the pill.
2. Click during `listening` → stop listening (same as Esc).
3. Click during `clarifying` → re-listen **with the clarification question kept in the transcript context** (INT-1 handles; the HUD only emits `hud:relisten`).
4. Click during `error` → `hud:retry`.
5. Hover during `idle` → tooltip.

Events emitted to the orchestrator (INT-1):

```ts
type HudEvent =
  | { type: 'hud:toggle' }
  | { type: 'hud:stop' }
  | { type: 'hud:retry' }
  | { type: 'hud:relisten' }
  | { type: 'hud:openSettings' };
```

The HUD is **stateless** — it renders `AgentStatus` and events; it never talks to the Brain or the DOM engine directly. (Single-responsibility; also makes it testable without the rest of the system.)

## Positions & collisions

- Bottom-centre by default; `bottom: 24px` + `env(safe-area-inset-bottom)`.
- If a fixed bottom bar covers > 60% of the width at the bottom (heuristic: any `position: fixed` element with `bottom < 40px` and `width > 60vw` whose rect intersects the pill's rect), move the pill to `bottom: 96px`. Recompute on scroll/resize with a 500 ms throttle.
- Never overlap the focused input: if the focused element's rect intersects the pill's rect, shift up by 64 px.
- Persist a user-drag offset? **No** — out of scope; document it.

## Structure

```text
packages/extension/src/content/hud/
├── mount.ts          # mountHud, host element, remount guard, destroy
├── controller.ts     # HudController implementation, state machine
├── styles.ts         # single exported CSS string (:host tokens + classes)
├── templates.ts      # per-state DOM builders (no innerHTML with user text — textContent ONLY)
├── collision.ts      # position heuristics (pure functions, unit-tested)
└── icons.ts          # inline SVGs (mic, spinner, check, alert)
```

**XSS rule:** transcript preview, `spokenFeedback`, clarification questions, and error messages are all untrusted strings (STT output, model output, page text). They must be assigned with `textContent`, never `innerHTML`. Add an ESLint rule/CI grep banning `innerHTML` in `packages/extension/src/content/`.

## Test plan

### Unit (jsdom)

| Test | Assertion |
| --- | --- |
| `mount-once` | calling `mountHud()` twice yields one host element |
| `states` | each of the 6 `AgentStatus` values renders the expected class + copy |
| `status-transitions` | `idle → listening → thinking → executing → idle` updates without leaks (listener counts stable) |
| `destroy` | host removed, all listeners removed, observers disconnected, timers cleared |
| `xss` | `setMessage('<img src=x onerror=alert(1)>')` → rendered as text, no `<img>` in the DOM |
| `remount-guard` | removing the host from the DOM triggers a re-mount exactly once; 4 removals in 10 s → max 3 remounts |
| `collision` | fake fixed bottom bar → pill moves up (pure function test) |
| `focused-overlap` | focused element under the pill → offset applied |
| `a11y` | `role=status`, `aria-live` correct per state, button has `aria-label` |

### Browser (Playwright) — CSS isolation proof

| Test | Assertion |
| --- | --- |
| `host-reset-immunity` | page with `* { all: unset !important }` / `button { display: none !important }` → pill still visible and 44 px tall |
| `no-leak` | page's `h1` computed styles unchanged after mount (compare before/after snapshots) |
| `z-index` | page with a `z-index: 2147483646` overlay → pill still on top (assert `document.elementFromPoint` at pill centre is inside the shadow root) |
| `scroll-stable` | pill stays at bottom-centre across 2000 px scroll |
| `fullscreen-iframe` | pill not rendered inside a cross-origin iframe (documented) |
| `reduced-motion` | `emulateMedia({ reducedMotion: 'reduce' })` → no animation classes |
| `keyboard` | `Alt+V` toggles; `Esc` stops; focus ring visible |

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Floating pill renders at bottom-centre of **any** website with `z-index: 2147483647`, unaffected by host CSS resets (proved by the Playwright isolation suite).
- [ ] All 6 states render with the specified copy and are driven purely by `AgentStatus`.
- [ ] Live transcript preview updates while `listening`.
- [ ] Host page CSS cannot break the HUD, and HUD CSS cannot affect the host (before/after computed-style snapshots equal).
- [ ] All untrusted text is rendered via `textContent` (XSS test passes; CI grep for `innerHTML` passes).
- [ ] `mountHud()` is idempotent; `destroy()` leaves zero residue (no listeners, observers, timers, or styles).
- [ ] Keyboard accessible (`Alt+V`, `Esc`, focus ring) and screen-reader correct.
- [ ] `prefers-reduced-motion` and `prefers-color-scheme` respected.
- [ ] Collision avoidance with fixed bottom bars and focused inputs.
- [ ] Bundle: HUD module < 20 KB min+gzip, zero runtime dependencies, zero remote assets.

## Non-goals

- A full settings panel in the HUD (popup owns settings).
- Draggable/repositionable pill.
- Toasts/notifications outside the pill.
- Localisation of HUD copy (English MVP; strings centralised in `templates.ts` for a future i18n pass).

## Definition of done

- Extension loads on 3 real sites (testbed, a big commerce site, a dashboard) with the pill visible and unaffected.
- `docs/extension/hud.md` includes screenshots of all 6 states and the CSS isolation strategy.
- PR title: `[E-1] Shadow-DOM HUD`.
